screens.title: Owner view
screens.caption: One screen the owner actually opens: each outlet scored from real inputs — POS, checklists, attendance, Tally — with the questions already sent to the right people.

screens.title: Outlet · Thillai Nagar
screens.caption: Drill into one outlet: every KPI with its source and weight, the trend, and the chain of questions that a breach triggered.

screens.title: Governance
screens.caption: Governance rules turn a number into a question to a named person with a deadline — and an escalation when the deadline passes. The owner sees the exceptions, not the spreadsheet.

screens.title: Collectors
screens.caption: Numbers are collected, not typed: phone checklists, POS and Tally connectors, attendance, WhatsApp — compiled every night into the formats the owner already uses.

screens.title: Digests
screens.caption: The digest is the product for most owners: five lines a day, each with a number, a person and a deadline, and a reply that opens the detail.

screens.title: KPIs & weights
screens.caption: The owner sets what matters and how much: KPIs, their sources, weights and thresholds — the compile does the rest, every night, for every outlet.

screens.title: Reports · weekly P&L
screens.caption: The weekly P&L per outlet that used to take an accountant two days — compiled from POS and Tally on Sunday night, in the owner's own format.
